transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I suppose I've just been feeling a bit uneasy lately. Even on my better days, I just... I can't seem to shake this feeling I have. 

It just seems like some of the people at my church, and in my walking club... it feels like they're watching me. And I keep noticing these little messages about me in the church bulletin, or just... hidden in the things they say when I'm around. I don't really know what else to say about it, but... I guess that's why I'm here.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been... a while, I suppose. Um. I guess it started not long after... well, after a close friend of mine passed away. That was about a year and five months ago.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people can't hear?

Well... I suppose... maybe sometimes. Um. Just when the house is very quiet. 

I might... I hear my name, or just a few words. It sounds exactly like my friend's voice. Usually coming from the kitchen, or out on the porch. It's clear enough that I... I actually answer back before I remember she's not there. But... that's really it.
Do you find it difficult to organize your thoughts or express them in a way that feels clear to you or others?

I suppose so. Sometimes... well, I'll try to explain something. Just something simple, about the mail or... or what happened at church. And then... 

I don't know, I just sort of... I end up talking about other things. Like the quilt patterns I used to make, or the birds outside, or... or those warnings I mentioned. And then I look at people and I can just see they don't know what I'm getting at. It's... it's hard to keep it all straight sometimes.
Do you have difficulty doing everyday tasks or maintaining your daily routine?

I suppose... maybe a little. Um. Sometimes I just... well, there are mornings when I find myself just standing by the front door. 

I'll have my purse in my hand, and... I just stand there for a long time. I don't go out. I just... I don't really know what I was about to do. But... I get by, mostly.
Have you been experiencing any unusual movements or restlessness?
No, I don't think so. I haven't noticed anything like that.
Do you believe that the messages you think you've seen in the church bulletin or heard in conversations are actually about you and intended to convey a specific meaning?

Well... yes. I suppose I do. It's... it's actually why I finally came in to see someone. Because even on my better days, I just can't seem to shake the feeling. 

I try to ignore it, but... it feels like some of the people at church, and... and the ones in my walking club, too... it feels like they're watching me. And those little things in the bulletin, or just the way they phrase things when they talk... it really does seem like they're putting messages in there. About me. I... I don't really like talking about it, but... yes.
Do you often find yourself engaging in behaviors that seem unusual or out of place to others?
Unusual? I... no. Not that I know of. I try to just... keep to myself, mostly. I don't think I do anything out of place.
How do you feel when you notice these messages or think someone is watching you?
I... I don't know. It just makes me feel... uncomfortable. I try not to dwell on it.
Do you think these messages and the feeling of being watched could be just your imagination or is it something you believe is really happening to you?

I... well, like I said a few minutes ago, that's really why I came in. Because... even on my better days, I just can't shake it. 

It feels real to me. The people at church, and the walking club... I don't think I'm imagining that they're watching me, or... or leaving those little messages. It... it feels like it's really happening.
How certain are you that these messages and the feeling of being watched are real?

I... I'm pretty certain. Like I just said... that's why I'm here. Even when I'm having a good day, I... I can't shake it. The people at church, the ones in my walking club... I know they're watching me. And the messages in the church bulletin, or... or just the things they say when I walk by... I know it's about me. It's real.
Do you think there's a specific reason why these people are watching you or leaving you messages?
I... no. I really don't know why. I... I just don't know what they want from me.
Do you think the people watching you or leaving you messages are working together or is it separate individuals acting on their own?
I... I'm not really sure. I haven't... I haven't really thought about it like that. I just know it's happening.
Do you often find yourself switching between unrelated ideas when talking to others?

I... I guess sometimes. When I try to explain things, I... I start out talking about the mail, or maybe church. But then... I don't know, it just turns into talking about quilt patterns, or the birds outside... and the warnings. I can tell people don't really know what I'm getting at. So I just... try to stay quiet.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to perform your job or participate in social activities since you started feeling uneasy and noticing these messages?

I... well, I don't work. I still live at home. But... I guess I haven't been doing much lately. I stopped going to the quilting gatherings... and the walking club. I just haven't been out in the garden much either. My daughter... she's been checking on me a lot more. Just... asking about my meals, and making sure I go to my appointments. That's all.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your ability to take care of yourself or manage your daily life since these feelings started?

I... I think I already said. I'm just... not doing as much. I haven't been to the quilting group, or walking... and my daughter, she's been coming by to check on my meals and appointments. That's really it.
Do you often have trouble staying on topic when you're talking to someone?

I... I thought I just answered that. It's like I was saying before. I'll start out talking about church or the mail, and then... I just end up on the quilt patterns, or the birds, or those warnings. And people just look at me because they don't know what I mean. I don't really have anything else to add to it.
Have you noticed any significant decline in your memory or ability to learn new things since these feelings started?
No, I... I haven't noticed anything like that. My memory is fine. I just... I remember things same as always.
Do you often feel like your thoughts are disjointed or hard to put into words?

I... I think I just explained that. It's like I said... I'll try to explain something about the mail, or church, and... then I'm talking about the quilt patterns, or the birds, or the warnings. And people just look at me because they don't understand what I'm getting at. That's... that's all it is.
